theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Z : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → ContDiff ℝ 1 Z → HasCompactSupport Z → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≠ ∞ → (∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ ∫⁻ x in M ∩ tsupport Z, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((((fderiv ℝ (fun y => y + t • Z y) x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((fderiv ℝ (fun y => y + t • Z y) x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL)).det)) ∂μHE[m]) → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ Z x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0
